# VadCLIP V21 — phương án A: fine-tune hai giai đoạn

## Phương án A — 19/11/2026 (cấu hình hiện hành)

- Full: 16 epochs = 4 head warm-up + 12 joint fine-tune. Smoke: 2 epochs,
  mỗi pha 1 epoch và tối đa 2 macro-batches/epoch, để kiểm tra mở khóa.
- Pha 1: adapter và prompt/fusion V0 đóng băng, đặt eval để tắt dropout/state updates.
  Chỉ projector, classifier, curvature và scale học. Head LR tăng tuyến tính theo epoch
  tới 1e-4; curvature/scale tới 1e-5. Giữ CLIP đóng băng cả hai pha.
- Pha 2: mở toàn bộ downstream; LR adapter/prompt=2e-5, head=5e-5,
  curvature/scale=5e-6. Cosine từ giá trị này tới 2% ở epoch cuối (từng nhóm).
  Giữ nguyên optimizer và Adam moments khi chuyển pha; không reset mô hình.
- Curvature vẫn init=0.5, trong (0.1,1); scale ảnh/chữ init=0.7; tau=0.07.
  Không áp curriculum c=0.01 của phương án B. Geometry/loss FP32, AMP=False.
- Chặn norm tangent tối đa 3 trước expmap ở cả video, text, prototype và sau FFN.
  Không normalize mọi mẫu thành cùng bán kính. Đây là biện pháp triển khai để ổn định,
  không phải thông số tác giả đã xác minh; log max_tangent_norm trong geometry receipt.
- Giữ BCE miền log đã sửa. Preflight vẫn chỉ dùng train, không có optimizer step.
  Kiểm gradient theo pha; không yêu cầu gradient adapter/prompt khi chúng bị đóng băng.
- Best checkpoint chọn trên development qua cả hai pha; chứa train_config/training_phase.
  Snapshot cuối lưu optimizer/scaler/RNG/lịch pha; chưa hỗ trợ auto-resume.
- Lỗi runtime được ghi log/failure.json nếu trainer còn hoạt động; dừng dataset lỗi,
  lưu ZIP phần đã có. Cell tải lấy được ZIP partial sau lỗi. Không nuốt lỗi để báo đạt.
  Kill session, mất điện hoặc hết disk không bảo đảm ghi được artifact.
- Đây là adaptation theo PoinCLIP-VAD với lịch A được đề xuất; không tuyên bố tái lập
  chính xác mã tác giả, không cam kết tăng benchmark. Chưa chạy GPU bản A.

## Nền sửa sau lượt lỗi run_bg0maqz8 — 19/11/2026

- BCE của mean(top-k sigmoid) được tính tương đương bằng logsumexp/logsigmoid,
  bỏ clamp xác suất gây mất gradient. Không thay thành BCE của mean logits.
- Mặc định AMP=False: downstream/loss float32; CLIP frozen giữ dtype nội bộ.
- Trước train có preflight tối đa 8 video train (4 normal/4 abnormal), không cập nhật
  optimizer, kiểm forward/backward hữu hạn và gradient BCE classifier khác 0.
- Khởi tạo hai projector được hiệu chỉnh bằng median norm trên chính mẫu train này:
  median norm sau projector đặt về 1, trước lambda=0.7. Đây là lựa chọn ổn định số
  của V21, không phải thông số tác giả đã công bố; không dùng test/dev để hiệu chỉnh.
  Lưu norm trước hiệu chỉnh và bảng BCE/logit/radius tại preflight.json và cell output.
- Kiểm tensor không hữu hạn trong training trước BCE; không thêm các kiểm tra đồng bộ
  này vào forward inference để tránh làm sai phép so latency.
- STOP_ON_FAILURE=True: một dataset lỗi thì đóng gói kết quả và dừng, không tự chạy
  thêm dataset còn lại. Không che lỗi bằng bỏ video hoặc trả metric giả.
- Schema checkpoint đổi sang v2; train mới từ V0, không nạp best/optimizer của lượt lỗi.
- Giữ 30 epoch/Adam/lr/WD/batch64, distance/tau một lần và protocol test hiện có.
  Giữ lọc giao nhóm nguồn: XD vẫn chỉ còn 1.600 video đủ điều kiện; không gọi đây là
  tái lập benchmark paper trên toàn bộ official train.
- Chạy RUN_MODE="smoke" trước; khi đạt đổi "full". Full cũng tự chạy preflight.
  Preflight không bảo đảm mọi batch tương lai hoặc benchmark sẽ đạt; lỗi phát sinh
  vẫn được báo rõ. Bản sửa chưa có kết quả GPU/benchmark mới.

Trên mỗi dataset: **V0 inference → train V21 Poincaré → V21 inference**.
Không train cosine control theo yêu cầu ngày 19/11/2026. Benchmark paper là động lực;
V21 chỉ có kết luận sau chạy thật. Không tự gán mức tăng của paper cho bản triển khai này.

## Input Kaggle — sáu gói như V20

1. UCF test290 features (`ucfclipfeatures_test290.zip`).
2. Checkpoint gốc `model_ucf.pth` hoặc ZIP checkpoint UCF.
3. `VadCLIP XD-Violence Test 800` (feature ZIP chuẩn bị trước).
4. Checkpoint gốc `model_xd.pth`.
5. `vadclip_ucf_train_v5.zip`.
6. `vadclip_xd_train_v5.zip`.

Không cần output V7/V20. CLIP ViT-B-16.pt gốc có thể gắn thêm để tránh tải.
Bật Internet và GPU Tesla T4. Tự dò input hoặc điền đường dẫn tại config.

## Những phần được học và hình học

- CLIP pretrained luôn đóng băng. Pha1 chỉ học geometry/classifier; pha2 học thêm
  adapter temporal/GCN, prompt parameters và FFN fusion.
- Projector d→d rồi expmap vào Poincaré ball, curvature=-c; không thêm chiều Lorentz.
  Nhánh C: sigmoid(-Poincaré distance tới prototype + bias).
- Prompt thị giác dùng attention C và logmap; FFN fusion trong tangent space rồi expmap.
  Nhánh A: -Poincaré distance/tau, nhiệt độ chỉ áp dụng một lần.
- Loss: BCE classification + video-label alignment + psi*entailment + phi*separation.
- Full: **16 epochs (4 + 12), Adam với LR theo nhóm/pha ở trên, WD=5e-5, cosine pha2, batch hiệu dụng 64**
  (32 normal/32 abnormal). Microbatch 1, tích lũy gradient để giảm VRAM.
  Mặc định downstream float32; CLIP giữ dtype nội bộ, loss float32. Đây là batch hiệu dụng qua
  accumulation, không khẳng định tốc độ/tương đương mọi phép toán với batch vật lý 64.
- Smoke: 2 epochs (1 mỗi pha), tối đa 2 macro-batches/epoch, batch hiệu dụng 4, dev nhỏ; không chấm benchmark.
- Train sample tối đa 256 snippets/video. Dev/test dùng đủ snippet qua block gốc.

## Checkpoint và giới hạn

Chia train/dev theo nhóm nguồn, loại nhóm tên giao test, chỉ dùng video labels để học.
Chọn epoch bằng dev **C-video AP trên UCF**, **A-video AP trên XD**, chạy đủ 16 epoch;
không dùng frame test labels để chọn. Warm-start adapter/prompt từ V0, thay C classifier.

Đây là adaptation downstream đầy đủ theo paper, **chưa phải tái lập chính xác code
tác giả** hoặc train từ đầu. Chưa tìm được repository tác giả trong nguồn đã kiểm.
Paper chưa đủ chi tiết về cone aperture, entailment regularizer, margin/pair mining;
giá trị config là lựa chọn triển khai công khai. Init projector identity/sqrt(d), c=0.5
và gradient clipping cũng là lựa chọn nội bộ. Giữ feature/split/evaluator VadCLIP hiện có.
Trunk V0 từng học train gốc gồm cả dev vừa tách; official test đã xem ở các version trước.
Kết quả là exploratory. Không có cosine retraining nên so V0/V21 đo toàn bộ thay đổi,
chưa tách riêng đóng góp của khoảng cách hình học khỏi tác động huấn luyện/kiến trúc.

## Log, latency và output

Cell in bảng căn cột cấu hình, từng epoch, hai nhánh C/A, primary metric, latency,
VRAM/params và delta so V0 cùng lượt. Bốn thành phần loss lưu trong history.json.
Bootstrap theo video cho cả C/A. Không ép C bất biến như bản cũ. Hash checkpoint
khởi tạo V0 và checkpoint thực đánh giá được ghi riêng.

Latency đo feature đã trên GPU → logits với CUDA sync/warmup/repeats. Không gồm decode
hay CLIP image feature extraction; không gọi end-to-end FPS. Giữ boundary như V0/V7/V20.
Không tính FLOPs, Base/Novel hay online delay.

ZIP chứa config/source/hash/split/history/metrics/latency/log và `best.pth` downstream.
Không chứa CLIP weights; cần V0 gốc để nạp lại. `last_training_state.pt` giữ trong thư
mục Kaggle, không đưa ZIP; snapshot phục hồi thủ công, chưa có auto-resume.
Predictions chỉ đưa ZIP khi INCLUDE_PREDICTIONS=True. Cell tải dùng link tương đối.

Lý thuyết: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-56792-z

SOURCES = {'v21_geometry.py': '"""Poincare geometry, curvature -c; fp32/fp64 math for the full V21 pipeline."""

import torch


def ball_epsilon(x, eps=None):
    """Boundary guard scaled to the precision actually used on the manifold."""
    return (1e-12 if x.dtype == torch.float64 else 1e-5) if eps is None else eps


def project_ball(x, c, eps=None):
    eps = ball_epsilon(x, eps)
    c = c.to(dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
    maximum = (1 - eps) / c.sqrt()
    norm = torch.linalg.vector_norm(x, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    return x * (maximum / norm.clamp_min(torch.finfo(x.dtype).tiny)).clamp(max=1.)


def expmap0(v, c, eps=None):
    """Equation (1): T_0 B_c^d -> B_c^d, with a continuous zero limit."""
    c = c.to(dtype=v.dtype, device=v.device)
    norm = torch.linalg.vector_norm(v, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    z = c.sqrt() * norm
    # Avoid 0/0 in the unselected branch: autograd still evaluates both branches.
    scale = torch.where(z > 1e-7, z.tanh() / z.clamp_min(1e-7), 1 - z.square() / 3)
    return project_ball(v * scale, c, eps)


def logmap0(x, c, eps=None):
    eps = ball_epsilon(x, eps)
    c = c.to(dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
    x = project_ball(x, c, eps)
    z = c.sqrt() * torch.linalg.vector_norm(x, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    z = z.clamp(max=1 - eps)
    scale = torch.where(z > 1e-7, torch.atanh(z) / z.clamp_min(1e-7), 1 + z.square() / 3)
    return x * scale


def poincare_distance(x, y, c, eps=None):
    """Equation (3), evaluated using an equivalent stable asinh identity.

    x/y broadcast over all leading axes; the last axis is the coordinate axis.
    d = 2/sqrt(c) * asinh(sqrt(c)*||x-y|| / sqrt((1-c||x||²)(1-c||y||²))).
    Direct vector differences avoid cancellation at x==y; norm has zero gradient
    at the origin in PyTorch. Geometry is calculated in fp32/fp64, never fp16.
    """
    eps = ball_epsilon(x, eps)
    c = c.to(dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
    x, y = project_ball(x, c, eps), project_ball(y, c, eps)
    dx = (1 - c * x.square().sum(-1)).clamp_min(eps)
    dy = (1 - c * y.square().sum(-1)).clamp_min(eps)
    delta = torch.linalg.vector_norm(x - y, dim=-1)
    return 2 / c.sqrt() * torch.asinh(c.sqrt() * delta / (dx * dy).sqrt())


def mobius_add(x, y, c):
    c = c.to(dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
    xy = (x * y).sum(-1, keepdim=True)
    xx, yy = x.square().sum(-1, keepdim=True), y.square().sum(-1, keepdim=True)
    return ((1 + 2 * c * xy + c * yy) * x + (1 - c * xx) * y) / (
        1 + 2 * c * xy + c.square() * xx * yy).clamp_min(1e-8)


def cone_energy(child, parent, c, space="poincare", aperture_scale=.1, regularizer=.01,
                diagnostics=False):
    """Eq.(11), using text as cone anchor, visual instance as child.

    Paper does not specify cone aperture scale, lambda_reg, or pair mining.
    These choices are explicit config. Poincare aperture follows Ganea 2018
    after scaling coordinates by sqrt(c); angle uses conformality and the
    direction log_parent(child). Euclidean control uses its straight tangent.
    A finite aperture guard is used near the cone domain's excluded origin.
    """
    c = c.to(dtype=parent.dtype, device=parent.device)
    eps = 1e-6
    radius = torch.linalg.vector_norm(parent, dim=-1)
    if space == "poincare":
        direction = mobius_add(-parent, child, c)
        aperture_denominator = c.sqrt() * radius
        aperture_argument = aperture_scale * (1 - c * radius.square()) / (
            aperture_denominator.clamp_min(eps))
    else:
        direction = child - parent
        aperture_denominator = radius
        aperture_argument = aperture_scale / aperture_denominator.clamp_min(eps)
    direction_norm = torch.linalg.vector_norm(direction, dim=-1)
    # atan2 gives the same exterior angle without clipping valid cosines near -1.
    # Compute the perpendicular vector directly, not sqrt(1-cosine**2), which
    # would lose small angles through cancellation. Protect atan2(0,0) first.
    unit_parent = parent / radius.unsqueeze(-1).clamp_min(eps)
    parallel = (unit_parent * direction).sum(-1)
    perpendicular = torch.linalg.vector_norm(
        direction - parallel.unsqueeze(-1) * unit_parent, dim=-1)
    degenerate = (direction_norm < eps) | (radius < eps)
    angle = torch.atan2(perpendicular, torch.where(degenerate, torch.ones_like(parallel), parallel))
    angle = torch.where(degenerate, torch.zeros_like(angle), angle)
    aperture = torch.asin(aperture_argument.clamp(eps, 1 - eps))
    energy = (angle - aperture).clamp_min(0) - regularizer * angle
    if not diagnostics:
        return energy
    cosine = (parent * direction).sum(-1) / (radius * direction_norm).clamp_min(eps)
    return energy, {
        "angle_method": "atan2",
        "legacy_acos_would_clip_fraction": ((cosine < -1 + eps) | (cosine > 1 - eps)).double().mean().detach(),
        "asin_clip_fraction": ((aperture_argument < eps) | (aperture_argument > 1 - eps)).double().mean().detach(),
        "legacy_cosine_denominator_would_clip_fraction": ((radius * direction_norm) < eps).double().mean().detach(),
        "parent_norm_guard_fraction": (radius < eps).double().mean().detach(),
        "aperture_denominator_guard_fraction": (aperture_denominator < eps).double().mean().detach(),
        "degenerate_fraction": degenerate.double().mean().detach(),
        "hinge_active_fraction": (angle > aperture).double().mean().detach(),
    }

', 'v21_model.py': '"""Full downstream V21: temporal/prompt training, CLS prototype and tangent fusion.

CLIP image/text parameters stay frozen, but the text encoder's input graph stays
enabled so gradients reach learned prompt tokens. Uses pinned VadCLIP's adapter
and prompt encoder methods; never its old Euclidean classification/alignment.
"""

import hashlib
import inspect
import math
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F
from v21_geometry import cone_energy, expmap0, logmap0, poincare_distance

SCHEMA = "v21_full_downstream_v5_sanity"


def finite(name, tensor):
    if not bool(torch.isfinite(tensor).all()):
        raise ValueError(f"Non-finite tensor before loss: {name}")


def pooled_binary_loss(logits, target, k):
    """BCE(mean(top-k sigmoid(z)), y), exactly in log space, without clamping p."""
    finite("classification logits", logits)
    z = logits.float().topk(k).values
    log_p = torch.logsumexp(F.logsigmoid(z), dim=0) - math.log(k)
    log_not_p = torch.logsumexp(F.logsigmoid(-z), dim=0) - math.log(k)
    return -target * log_p - (1 - target) * log_not_p


class GeometryHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dimension=512, curvature=.5, scale=.7, temperature=.07,
                 chunk_size=64, space="poincare", max_tangent_norm=None,
                 curvature_min=.1, curvature_max=1., text_projection=True,
                 geometry_dtype="float32", encoder_precision="inherit",
                 curvature_trainable=True, max_relative_radius=None):
        super().__init__()
        if (space not in {"cosine", "poincare"}
                or not 0 < curvature_min < curvature < curvature_max
                or not all(math.isfinite(v) for v in (curvature_min, curvature, curvature_max))):
            raise ValueError("Invalid model geometry")
        if dimension < 1 or scale <= 0 or temperature <= 0 or chunk_size < 1:
            raise ValueError("Invalid geometry dimensions/scales")
        self.space, self.temperature, self.chunk_size = space, temperature, chunk_size
        if max_tangent_norm is not None and (
                not math.isfinite(max_tangent_norm) or max_tangent_norm <= 0):
            raise ValueError("max_tangent_norm must be finite and positive")
        self.max_tangent_norm = max_tangent_norm
        if max_relative_radius is not None and (
                not math.isfinite(max_relative_radius) or not 0 < max_relative_radius < 1):
            raise ValueError("max_relative_radius must be in (0,1)")
        if max_relative_radius is not None and max_tangent_norm is not None:
            raise ValueError("Select smooth radius limiting or legacy hard clipping, not both")
        self.max_relative_radius = max_relative_radius
        self.register_buffer("visual_norm_scale", torch.ones(()))
        self.register_buffer("text_norm_scale", torch.ones(()))
        if geometry_dtype not in {"float32", "float64"}:
            raise ValueError("geometry_dtype must be float32 or float64")
        self.geometry_dtype = geometry_dtype
        if encoder_precision not in {"inherit", "float32"}:
            raise ValueError("encoder_precision must be inherit or float32")
        self.encoder_precision = encoder_precision
        self.visual = nn.Linear(dimension, dimension, bias=False)
        self.text = nn.Linear(dimension, dimension, bias=False) if text_projection else nn.Identity()
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.visual.weight.copy_(torch.eye(dimension) / math.sqrt(dimension))
            if text_projection:
                self.text.weight.copy_(torch.eye(dimension) / math.sqrt(dimension))
        self.curvature_min, self.curvature_max = curvature_min, curvature_max
        self.raw_c = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(math.log(
            (curvature - curvature_min) / (curvature_max - curvature))))
        self.raw_v = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(math.log(math.expm1(scale))))
        self.raw_t = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(math.log(math.expm1(scale))))
        self.prototype = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(dimension) * .01)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(()))
        if space == "cosine" or not curvature_trainable:
            self.raw_c.requires_grad_(False)

    @property
    def curvature(self):
        return self.curvature_min + (self.curvature_max - self.curvature_min) * self.raw_c.sigmoid()

    def map_visual(self, features):
        return self.map_tangent(self.visual_tangent(features))

    def map_text(self, features):
        return self.map_tangent(self.text_tangent(features))

    def visual_tangent(self, features):
        return F.softplus(self.raw_v) * self.visual(features.float()) / self.visual_norm_scale

    def text_tangent(self, features):
        return F.softplus(self.raw_t) * self.text(features.float()) / self.text_norm_scale

    @torch.no_grad()
    def set_modality_norms(self, visual, text):
        if not all(math.isfinite(n) and n > 1e-8 for n in (visual, text)):
            raise ValueError("Conditioning norms must be finite and positive")
        self.visual_norm_scale.fill_(visual)
        self.text_norm_scale.fill_(text)

    def map_tangent(self, tangent):
        if self.space != "poincare":
            return tangent
        tangent = tangent.double() if self.geometry_dtype == "float64" else tangent.float()
        if self.max_relative_radius is not None:
            # Smooth radial compression; direction and relative norm information
            # remain variable. This is a disclosed stabilization, not paper Eq1 verbatim.
            limit = math.atanh(self.max_relative_radius) / self.curvature.to(tangent).sqrt()
            z = tangent.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True) / limit
            factor = torch.where(z > 1e-7, z.tanh() / z.clamp_min(1e-7), 1 - z.square() / 3)
            tangent = tangent * factor
        if self.max_tangent_norm is not None:
            norm = tangent.norm(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-8)
            tangent = tangent * (self.max_tangent_norm / norm).clamp(max=1.)
        return expmap0(tangent, self.curvature)

    def classify(self, visual):
        if self.space == "poincare":
            prototype = self.map_tangent(self.prototype)
            distance = poincare_distance(visual, prototype, self.curvature)
        else:
            distance = torch.linalg.vector_norm(visual - self.prototype, dim=-1)
        return (-distance + self.bias).unsqueeze(-1)

    def align(self, visual, text):
        if self.space == "cosine":
            return F.normalize(visual, dim=-1) @ F.normalize(text, dim=-1).transpose(-1, -2) / self.temperature
        return torch.cat([
            -poincare_distance(visual[:, i:i + self.chunk_size, None], text[:, None],
                               self.curvature) / self.temperature
            for i in range(0, visual.shape[1], self.chunk_size)
        ], dim=1)

    def receipt(self):
        return {"space": self.space, "curvature_magnitude": float(self.curvature.detach()),
                "lambda_visual": float(F.softplus(self.raw_v).detach()),
                "lambda_text": float(F.softplus(self.raw_t).detach()),
                "temperature": self.temperature, "chunk_size": self.chunk_size,
                "max_tangent_norm": self.max_tangent_norm,
                "text_projection": isinstance(self.text, nn.Linear),
                "geometry_dtype": self.geometry_dtype,
                "encoder_precision": self.encoder_precision,
                "boundary_epsilon": 1e-12 if self.geometry_dtype == "float64" else 1e-5,
                "curvature_trainable": self.raw_c.requires_grad,
                "max_relative_radius": self.max_relative_radius,
                "visual_norm_scale": float(self.visual_norm_scale),
                "text_norm_scale": float(self.text_norm_scale),
                "parameters": sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters()),
                "scope": "full CLS, tangent-space prompt fusion and alignment"}


class FullPipeline(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, base, space, geometry_config):
        super().__init__()
        required = ("encode_video", "encode_textprompt", "mlp1", "clipmodel")
        if any(not hasattr(base, name) for name in required):
            raise ValueError("Pinned VadCLIP lacks the expected adapter/prompt/CLIP API")
        self.base = base
        self.geometry_config = dict(geometry_config)
        self.space = space
        # Old Euclidean C block is replaced, not left trainable but unused.
        self.base.classifier = nn.Identity()
        self.base.mlp2 = nn.Identity()
        for name, module in self.base.named_children():
            if name != "clipmodel":
                module.float()
        self.base.requires_grad_(True)
        self.base.clipmodel.requires_grad_(False).eval()
        self.geometry = GeometryHead(space=space, **geometry_config)
        if self.geometry.encoder_precision == "float32":
            # CLIP's loader can explicitly store half weights and cast its inputs
            # to self.dtype. Disabling autocast alone does not undo those casts.
            self.base.float()

    def train(self, mode=True):
        super().train(mode)
        self.base.clipmodel.eval()
        return self

    def forward_with_aux(self, images, padding_mask, text, lengths):
        if self.geometry.encoder_precision == "float32":
            with torch.autocast(device_type=images.device.type, enabled=False):
                visual = self.base.encode_video(images.float(), padding_mask, lengths)
                # Frozen weights, enabled input graph: prompts must still learn.
                text_raw = self.base.encode_textprompt(text)
        else:
            visual = self.base.encode_video(images, padding_mask, lengths)
            text_raw = self.base.encode_textprompt(text)
        if self.training:
            finite("adapter output", visual)
            finite("text encoder output", text_raw)
        if visual.ndim != 3 or text_raw.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Expected adapter [B,T,d] and prompt [M,d]")
        if visual.shape[-1] != self.geometry.visual.in_features or text_raw.shape[-1] != visual.shape[-1]:
            raise ValueError("Embedding dimension mismatch")
        lengths = torch.as_tensor(lengths, device=images.device)
        valid = torch.arange(images.shape[1], device=images.device)[None] < lengths[:, None]
        with torch.autocast(device_type=images.device.type, enabled=False):
            visual_tangent = self.geometry.visual_tangent(visual)
            text_tangent = self.geometry.text_tangent(text_raw)
            x = self.geometry.map_tangent(visual_tangent)
            t = self.geometry.map_tangent(text_tangent)
            logits_c = self.geometry.classify(x)
            if self.space == "poincare":
                tangent_x = logmap0(x, self.geometry.curvature)
                tangent_t = logmap0(t, self.geometry.curvature)
            else:
                tangent_x, tangent_t = x, t
            attention = logits_c.sigmoid() * valid.unsqueeze(-1)
            prompt = F.normalize((attention * tangent_x).sum(1), dim=-1, eps=1e-6)
            fused = self.base.mlp1((prompt[:, None] + tangent_t[None]).float()) + tangent_t[None]
            instance_text = self.geometry.map_tangent(fused)
            logits_a = self.geometry.align(x, instance_text)
        if self.training:
            finite("visual ball", x)
            finite("instance text ball", instance_text)
            finite("alignment logits", logits_a)

               "adapter": visual, "encoder_text": text_raw, "class_text": t,
               "visual_tangent": visual_tangent, "text_tangent": text_tangent,
               "fused_tangent": fused,
               "curvature": self.geometry.curvature}
        return text_raw, logits_c, logits_a, aux

    def forward(self, images, padding_mask, text, lengths):
        raw, c, a, _ = self.forward_with_aux(images, padding_mask, text, lengths)
        return raw, c, a

    def parameter_groups(self):
        groups = {"frozen_clip": 0, "temporal_adapter": 0, "prompt_fusion": 0,
                  "geometry_classifier": 0, "other_downstream": 0}
        for name, parameter in self.named_parameters():
            group = self.parameter_group(name)
            if group == "frozen_clip":
                if parameter.requires_grad:
                    raise ValueError("CLIP parameter unexpectedly trainable")
            groups[group] += parameter.numel()
        return groups

    @staticmethod
    def parameter_group(name):
        if name.startswith("base.clipmodel."):
            return "frozen_clip"
        if name.startswith("geometry."):
            return "geometry_classifier"
        if name.startswith(("base.text_prompt", "base.mlp1")):
            return "prompt_fusion"
        if name.startswith(("base.temporal", "base.gc", "base.linear", "base.disAdj",
                            "base.frame_position")):
            return "temporal_adapter"
        return "other_downstream"

    def gradient_receipt(self):
        result = {group: False for group in self.parameter_groups()}
        for name, p in self.named_parameters():
            if p.grad is not None and bool(p.grad.abs().sum() > 0):
                result[self.parameter_group(name)] = True
        result["prompt_tokens"] = any(
            p.grad is not None and bool(p.grad.abs().sum() > 0)
            for name, p in self.named_parameters() if name.startswith("base.text_prompt"))
        result["clip_parameter_gradients"] = result.pop("frozen_clip")
        return result

    def downstream_state(self):
        return {name: value.detach().cpu().clone() for name, value in self.state_dict().items()
                if not name.startswith("base.clipmodel.")}

    def load_downstream(self, state):
        expected = {name for name in self.state_dict() if not name.startswith("base.clipmodel.")}
        if set(state) != expected:
            raise ValueError("Full downstream checkpoint schema/keys mismatch")
        result = self.load_state_dict(state, strict=False)
        if result.unexpected_keys or any(not k.startswith("base.clipmodel.") for k in result.missing_keys):
            raise ValueError("Unexpected missing downstream model weights")


def topk_size(count, abnormal):
    return min(count, 1 + count // 16) if abnormal else 1


def full_loss(logits_c, logits_a, targets, lengths, aux, space, config):
    """Eq.(13) per video. Only video labels; temporal padding is excluded."""
    if targets.ndim != 2 or targets.shape != (logits_a.shape[0], logits_a.shape[-1]):
        raise ValueError("Video labels and logits have different class/batch axes")
    if (targets.sum(-1) <= 0).any() or ((targets[:, 0] > 0) & (targets[:, 1:].sum(-1) > 0)).any():
        raise ValueError("Unknown/conflicting video labels")
    components = {key: [] for key in ("bce", "alignment", "entailment", "contrastive")}
    for batch in range(len(targets)):
        count = int(lengths[batch])
        if count < 1 or count > logits_a.shape[1]:
            raise ValueError("Invalid valid sequence length")
        target = targets[batch].float()
        abnormal = bool(target[0] == 0)
        k = topk_size(count, abnormal)
        c = logits_c[batch, :count, 0].float()
        a = logits_a[batch, :count].float()
        finite("alignment loss input", a)
        components["bce"].append(pooled_binary_loss(c, 1 - target[0], k))
        pooled = a.topk(k, dim=0).values.mean(0)
        alignment_temperature = config.get("alignment_loss_temperature", 1.)
        if not math.isfinite(alignment_temperature) or alignment_temperature <= 0:
            raise ValueError("alignment_loss_temperature must be finite and positive")
        components["alignment"].append(-(target / target.sum() * F.log_softmax(
            pooled / alignment_temperature, -1)).sum())
        x, text = aux["visual"][batch, :count], aux["text"][batch]
        pairs = []
        for category in torch.nonzero(target > 0, as_tuple=False).flatten():
            positions = a[:, category].topk(k).indices
            pairs.append(cone_energy(x[positions], text[category], aux["curvature"], space,
                                     config["cone_aperture_scale"], config["entail_regularizer"]).mean())
        components["entailment"].append(torch.stack(pairs).mean())
        if space == "poincare":
            distance = poincare_distance(text[0], text[1:], aux["curvature"])
        else:
            distance = torch.linalg.vector_norm(text[0] - text[1:], dim=-1)
        components["contrastive"].append((config["separation_margin"] - distance).clamp_min(0).sum())
    values = {key: torch.stack(value) for key, value in components.items()}
    total = (values["bce"] + values["alignment"] + config["psi"] * values["entailment"]
             + config["phi"] * values["contrastive"])
    return total, values


def load_full_model(base, space, geometry_config, checkpoint, expected_sha256,
                    initial_v0_sha256, device):
    path = Path(checkpoint)
    if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected_sha256:
        raise ValueError("Trained downstream checkpoint SHA-256 mismatch")
    payload = torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    if (payload.get("schema") != SCHEMA or payload.get("space") != space
            or payload.get("initial_v0_sha256") != initial_v0_sha256
            or payload.get("geometry_config") != geometry_config):
        raise ValueError("Full V21 checkpoint recipe/warm-start mismatch")
    if payload.get("train_config", {}).get("single_temperature") and (
            payload.get("loss_config", {}).get("alignment_loss_temperature", 1.) != 1.):
        raise ValueError("Checkpoint violates the single-temperature training/inference contract")
    model = FullPipeline(base, space, geometry_config).to(device)
    model.load_downstream(payload["downstream"])
    model.eval()
    provenance = {
        "schema": SCHEMA, "trained_checkpoint_sha256": expected_sha256,
        "initial_v0_sha256": initial_v0_sha256, "epoch": payload["epoch"],
        "parameter_groups": model.parameter_groups(), "trainable_scope": "all downstream; CLIP frozen",
        "encoder_api_source_sha256": {
            name: hashlib.sha256(inspect.getsource(getattr(type(base), name)).encode()).hexdigest()
            for name in ("encode_video", "encode_textprompt")
        },
    }
    return model, provenance

def _forward_call(node):
    return (isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and isinstance(node.value, ast.Call)
            and isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name) and node.value.func.id == "model")


def _native_bindings(statements, end, functions):
    """Bind inputs by the actual forward/loss call sites, never by guessed names.

    UCF uses feat_lengths/text_labels/CLASM in the pinned source. The labels
    supplied by our loader are already encoded, so the source variable receiving
    them must be identified at the loss call, not taken from the raw loader label.
    """
    starts = [i for i, node in enumerate(statements[:end]) if _forward_call(node)]
    if not starts:
        raise ValueError("Pinned native model forward call missing before loss")
    start = starts[-1]
    node = statements[start]
    if (len(node.targets) != 1 or not isinstance(node.targets[0], (ast.Tuple, ast.List))
            or len(node.targets[0].elts) != 3
            or any(not isinstance(n, ast.Name) for n in node.targets[0].elts)
            or len(node.value.args) != 4 or not isinstance(node.value.args[-1], ast.Name)):
        raise ValueError("Unsupported pinned native forward input/output signature")
    text, c, a = [n.id for n in node.targets[0].elts]
    length_name = node.value.args[-1].id
    bindings = {text: "_native_text", c: "_native_c", a: "_native_a",
                length_name: "_native_lengths"}
    observed, labels, devices = set(), set(), set()
    for statement in statements[start + 1:end + 1]:
        for call in ast.walk(statement):
            if not (isinstance(call, ast.Call) and isinstance(call.func, ast.Name)
                    and call.func.id in functions and call.args
                    and isinstance(call.args[0], ast.Name) and call.args[0].id in {c, a}):
                continue
            if (len(call.args) != 4 or any(not isinstance(n, ast.Name) for n in call.args)
                    or call.args[2].id != length_name):
                raise ValueError("Unsupported pinned native loss input signature")
            observed.add(call.args[0].id)
            labels.add(call.args[1].id)
            devices.add(call.args[3].id)
    if observed != {c, a} or len(labels) != 1 or len(devices) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Cannot unambiguously bind encoded labels/lengths for both native branches")
    label_name, device_name = next(iter(labels)), next(iter(devices))
    if label_name in bindings or device_name in bindings or label_name == device_name:
        raise ValueError("Conflicting native input aliases")
    bindings.update({label_name: "_native_targets", device_name: "_native_device"})
    return start, bindings


def native_objective(source, filename="pinned_train.py"):

    Keeps the actual native loss helpers and text contrastive expression, including
    its actual coefficient/reduction. In particular, no guessed paper loss is
    substituted. Expected tensors are logits [B,T,1]/[B,T,M], text [M,D], video
    labels [B,M], and valid lengths [B]. Return values are microbatch means.
    """

    if len(train) != 1:
        raise ValueError("Native objective requires one pinned train() function")

                        candidates.append((value, index))

    inputs = set(bindings)

                       "enumerate", "zip", "min", "max", "sum", "abs"}
    needed, selected = {"loss", "loss1", "loss2", "loss3"}, []
    for node in reversed(statements[start + 1:end + 1]):
        stores = {n.id for n in ast.walk(node)
                  if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Store)}
        if not (stores & needed):
            continue
        if not isinstance(node, (ast.Assign, ast.AugAssign, ast.For)):
            raise ValueError("Unexpected native objective control flow")
        loads = {n.id for n in ast.walk(node)
                 if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Load)}
        # A loop accumulator reads its old value, although AugAssign marks Store.
        accumulators = {n.target.id for n in ast.walk(node)
                        if isinstance(n, ast.AugAssign) and isinstance(n.target, ast.Name)}
        internal = stores - accumulators if isinstance(node, ast.For) else set()
        needed = (needed - stores) | (loads - internal) | accumulators
        selected.append(node)

        raise ValueError("Pinned native loss helpers missing")

        name = pending.pop()
        dependencies = {n.id for n in ast.walk(functions[name])
                        if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and isinstance(n.ctx, ast.Load)} & set(functions)
        new = dependencies - helper_names
        helper_names.update(new)
        pending.extend(sorted(new))

    if unresolved:
        raise ValueError(f"Unresolved pinned native loss inputs: {sorted(unresolved)}")

                   if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in helper_names]
    wrapper = ast.parse(
        "def extracted_loss(_native_text, _native_c, _native_a, _native_targets, _native_lengths, _native_device):\n"
        "    pass\n").body[0]
    aliases = [ast.Assign(targets=[ast.Name(id=name, ctx=ast.Store())],
                          value=ast.Name(id=parameter, ctx=ast.Load()))
               for name, parameter in bindings.items()]
    wrapper.body = aliases + list(reversed(selected)) + [ast.parse(
        "return loss, loss1, loss2, loss3").body[0]]
    module = ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=definitions + [wrapper], type_ignores=[]))
    namespace = {"torch": torch, "nn": nn, "F": F, "np": np}
    exec(compile(module, filename, "exec"), namespace)
    extracted = ast.unparse(module)
    receipt = {"source_file": Path(filename).name,
               "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),
               "extracted_sha256": hashlib.sha256(extracted.encode()).hexdigest(),
               "extracted_source": extracted,
               "extraction_contract": 2,
               "input_bindings": bindings,
               "native_loss_helpers": sorted(helper_names),
               "scope": "native objective; matched V21 loader/optimizer/budget, not original recipe"}

    def objective(c, a, targets, lengths, aux, space, config):
        if space != "native_cosine":
            raise ValueError("Native loss used with a different model family")
        if targets.shape != (a.shape[0], a.shape[-1]) or (
                (targets.sum(-1) <= 0).any() or
                ((targets[:, 0] > 0) & (targets[:, 1:].sum(-1) > 0)).any()):
            raise ValueError("Unknown/conflicting native video labels")
        sizes = torch.as_tensor(lengths, device=c.device)
        if bool(((sizes < 1) | (sizes > c.shape[1])).any()):
            raise ValueError("Invalid native valid sequence lengths")
        values = namespace["extracted_loss"](
            aux["encoder_text"], c, a, targets.float(), lengths, c.device)
        values = [v if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else c.new_tensor(v) for v in values]
        if any(v.numel() != 1 for v in values):
            raise ValueError("Native loss must return scalar microbatch means")

            ("bce", "alignment", "contrastive"), [v.reshape(1) for v in values[1:]], strict=True))

class NativePipeline(FullPipeline):
    """Keep native heads/fusion intact; call the captured unbound upstream forward.

    Capturing forward explicitly avoids recursion when evaluators instrument or
    replace CLIPVAD.forward. Diagnostics attach temporary hooks only during train.
    """

    def __init__(self, base, native_forward=None):
        nn.Module.__init__(self)
        if any(not hasattr(base, n) for n in ("classifier", "mlp1", "mlp2", "linear")):
            raise ValueError("Native control requires unmodified VadCLIP heads")
        self.base, self.space = base, "native_cosine"
        self._native_forward = native_forward or type(base).forward
        self.base.float().requires_grad_(True)
        self.base.clipmodel.requires_grad_(False).eval()

    def forward(self, images, padding_mask, text, lengths):
        with torch.autocast(device_type=images.device.type, enabled=False):
            result = self._native_forward(self.base, images.float(), padding_mask, text, lengths)
        if len(result) != 3:
            raise ValueError("Pinned native forward must return text, C logits, A logits")
        if self.training:
            for value in result:
                finite("native forward", value)
        return result

        captured = []
        handle = self.base.linear.register_forward_hook(lambda module, args, value: captured.append(value))
        try:
            raw, c, a = self(images, padding_mask, text, lengths)
        finally:
            handle.remove()
        if len(captured) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("Native forward must execute the temporal output FC exactly once")
        sizes = torch.as_tensor(lengths, device=images.device)
        valid = torch.arange(images.shape[1], device=images.device)[None] < sizes[:, None]
        return raw, c, a, {"adapter": captured[0], "encoder_text": raw, "valid": valid}

    def parameter_groups(self):
        groups = dict.fromkeys(("frozen_clip", "temporal_adapter", "prompt_fusion",
                                "classification_head", "other_downstream"), 0)
        for name, parameter in self.named_parameters():
            groups[self.parameter_group(name)] += parameter.numel()
        return groups

    @staticmethod
    def parameter_group(name):
        if name.startswith(("base.classifier.", "base.mlp2.")):
            return "classification_head"
        return FullPipeline.parameter_group(name)

    def model_receipt(self):
        return {"space": self.space, "heads": "pinned native classifier/mlp2 and cosine alignment",
                "fusion": "pinned native forward", "encoder_precision": "float32",
                "poincare_mapping": False, "norm_conditioning": False,
                "scope": "architecture/objective control under matched V21 training recipe"}

def balanced_batches(indices, abnormal, half, seed):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    positive = rng.permutation(indices[abnormal[indices]])
    normal = rng.permutation(indices[~abnormal[indices]])
    batches = (max(len(positive), len(normal)) + half - 1) // half
    positive = np.resize(positive, batches * half).reshape(batches, half)
    normal = np.resize(normal, batches * half).reshape(batches, half)
    return np.concatenate((normal, positive), axis=1)

    pending.replace(path)

            raise ValueError("weight_decay must be finite and nonnegative")

        self.finetune_epochs = 1 if smoke else cfg["finetune_epochs"]

        self.phase, self.epoch = None, -1

        self.names = {}

            if name.startswith("base.clipmodel."):
                parameter.requires_grad_(False)
                continue
            if name == "geometry.raw_c":
                kind = "curvature"
            elif name in {"geometry.raw_v", "geometry.raw_t"}:
                kind = "scale"
            elif name.startswith("geometry."):
                kind = "head"
            elif model.parameter_group(name) == "prompt_fusion":
                kind = "prompt"
            else:
                kind = "adapter"
            # Scalars and bias/gain vectors are not decayed.
            decay = config["weight_decay"] if parameter.ndim >= 2 else 0.
            buckets.setdefault((kind, decay), []).append(parameter)
            self.names[name] = kind
        if not {"head", "curvature", "scale", "adapter", "prompt"} <= {
                kind for kind, _ in buckets}:
            raise ValueError("Missing required parameter groups for two-stage training")
        self.optimizer = torch.optim.Adam([
            {"params": parameters, "kind": kind, "lr": 0., "weight_decay": decay}
            for (kind, decay), parameters in buckets.items()
        ], lr=cfg["head_lr"])

    def begin_epoch(self, epoch):
        if type(epoch) is not int or not 0 <= epoch < self.epochs:
            raise ValueError("Epoch outside two-stage schedule")
        self.epoch = epoch
        self.phase = "head_warmup" if epoch < self.warmup_epochs else "joint_finetune"
        cfg = self.settings
        if self.phase == "head_warmup":
            factor = (epoch + 1) / self.warmup_epochs
            rates = {"head": cfg["head_lr"], "curvature": cfg["curvature_lr"],
                     "scale": cfg["scale_lr"], "adapter": 0., "prompt": 0.}
        else:
            step = epoch - self.warmup_epochs
            progress = step / max(1, self.finetune_epochs - 1)
            factor = cfg["end_lr_ratio"] + (1 - cfg["end_lr_ratio"]) * (
                1 + math.cos(math.pi * progress)) / 2
            rates = {"head": cfg["finetune_head_lr"], "curvature": cfg["finetune_curvature_lr"],
                     "scale": cfg["finetune_scale_lr"], "adapter": cfg["adapter_lr"],

            kind = self.names.get(name)

                "learning_rates": {g["kind"]: g["lr"] for g in self.optimizer.param_groups},

def optimizer_update(model, optimizer, scaler, backward, *, amp, gradient_clip=None,

    cuda_state = torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None
    numpy_state, python_state = np.random.get_state(), random.getstate()
    generator_state = copy.deepcopy(rng.bit_generator.state) if rng is not None else None
    buffers = {name: value.detach().clone() for name, value in model.named_buffers()}
    events = []

    def write_diagnostics(status):

            path = Path(diagnostics_path)

            path.write_text(json.dumps({"status": status, "attempts": events}, indent=2),

def load_prediction(path):
    report = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    with np.load(Path(path).with_name("predictions.npz"), allow_pickle=False) as data:
        arrays = dict(data)
    id_key = "video_id" if "video_id" in arrays else "official_path"
    ids = arrays[id_key].astype(str)
    offsets = arrays["snippet_offsets"]
    scores, gt = arrays["scores"], arrays["frame_gt"].reshape(-1)
    fpf = report["frames_per_feature"]
    if (type(fpf) is not int or fpf < 1 or len(ids) != len(set(ids)) or
            len(arrays["video_label"]) != len(ids) or offsets.shape != (len(ids) + 1,) or
            offsets.dtype.kind not in "iu" or offsets[0] != 0 or
            bool((np.diff(offsets) <= 0).any()) or offsets[-1] != len(scores) or
            scores.shape != (offsets[-1], 2) or
            not np.isfinite(scores).all() or bool(((scores < 0) | (scores > 1)).any()) or
            len(gt) != offsets[-1] * fpf or not np.isin(gt, [0, 1]).all()):
        raise ValueError("Invalid saved ID/offset/score/frame-GT grid")
    arrays["ids"] = ids
    return report, arrays


def probability_replay(trace, directory):
    """Check saved device probabilities against an independent FP64 CPU reference.

    CPU and CUDA reductions are not bitwise interchangeable. Use a disclosed
    absolute budget in probability space based on the stored logit precision
    and class count. Never replace the probabilities used for benchmark metrics.
    """
    z = torch.from_numpy(trace["classification_logits"])
    align = torch.from_numpy(trace["alignment_logits"])
    if z.ndim != 1 or align.ndim != 2 or align.shape[1] < 2:
        raise ValueError("Invalid raw diagnostic logit shapes")
    if any(trace[key].dtype not in (np.float32, np.float64) for key in ("classification_logits", "alignment_logits")):
        raise ValueError("Replay requires stored FP32/FP64 logits")
    eps = [np.finfo(trace[key].dtype).eps for key in ("classification_logits", "alignment_logits")]
    tolerances = [float(max(8*eps[0], 64*np.finfo(np.float64).eps)),
                  float(max((align.shape[1]+4)*eps[1], 64*np.finfo(np.float64).eps))]
    reference = torch.stack((z.double().sigmoid(), 1-align.double().softmax(-1)[:, 0]), -1).numpy()
    error = np.abs(reference-trace["scores"])
    rows, examples = [], []
    for column, branch in enumerate(("classification", "alignment")):
        bad = np.flatnonzero(error[:, column] > tolerances[column])
        rows.append({"branch": branch, "absolute_tolerance": tolerances[column],
                     "max_absolute_error": float(error[:, column].max()),
                     "p99_absolute_error": float(np.quantile(error[:, column], .99)),
                     "mismatch_count": len(bad), "stored_logit_dtype": str((z, align)[column].dtype)})
        for token in sorted(bad, key=lambda i: error[i, column], reverse=True)[:10]:
            video = int(np.searchsorted(trace["snippet_offsets"], token, side="right")-1)
            examples.append({"video_id": str(trace["video_id"][video]), "branch": branch,
                             "snippet_index": int(token-trace["snippet_offsets"][video]),
                             "recorded_probability": float(trace["scores"][token, column]),
                             "reference_probability_fp64": float(reference[token, column]),
                             "absolute_error": float(error[token, column]),
                             "raw_logits": (float(z[token]) if column == 0 else align[token].tolist())})
    receipt = {"schema": "v21_probability_replay_v2", "reference": "CPU float64 from stored raw logits",
               "policy": "absolute probability error: C 8*eps; A (classes+4)*eps; floor 64*eps64",
               "status": "failed" if examples else "passed", "branches": rows, "examples": examples,
               "benchmark_scores_modified": False,
               "scope": "cross-backend numerical check; ID/offset/export/GT/metric checks are separate"}
    (Path(directory) / "probability_replay.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(receipt, indent=2, allow_nan=False), encoding="utf-8")
    if examples:
        worst = examples[0]
        raise ValueError(f"Saved raw logits do not reproduce trace probabilities beyond dtype budget: "
                         f"{worst['video_id']}/{worst['branch']}/snippet={worst['snippet_index']}; "
                         f"abs_error={worst['absolute_error']:.9g}; see probability_replay.json")
    return receipt


def load_trace(path, arrays):
    directory = Path(path).parent / "diagnostics"
    with np.load(directory / "diagnostic_tensors.npz", allow_pickle=False) as data:
        trace = dict(data)
    trace_ids, offsets = trace["video_id"].astype(str), trace["snippet_offsets"]
    if len(trace_ids) != len(set(trace_ids)) or set(trace_ids) != set(arrays["ids"]):
        raise ValueError("Trace/evaluator video identities differ")
    if (offsets.shape != (len(trace_ids) + 1,) or offsets[0] != 0 or
            offsets.dtype.kind not in "iu" or bool((np.diff(offsets) <= 0).any())):
        raise ValueError("Invalid trace offsets")
    keys = ("classification_logits", "alignment_logits", "alignment_log_odds", "scores",
            "adapter_norm", "feature_norm", "block_index")
    for key in keys:
        if len(trace[key]) != offsets[-1] or not np.isfinite(trace[key]).all():
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid diagnostic tensor: {key}")
    if trace["scores"].shape != arrays["scores"].shape:
        raise ValueError("Diagnostic score columns differ from evaluator")
    align = torch.from_numpy(trace["alignment_logits"])
    probability_replay(trace, directory)
    odds = (torch.logsumexp(align.double()[:, 1:], -1)-align.double()[:, 0]).numpy()
    if not np.allclose(odds, trace["alignment_log_odds"], rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-8):
        raise ValueError("Saved alignment log odds differ from raw alignment logits")
    index = {video_id: i for i, video_id in enumerate(trace_ids)}
    aligned = {key: [] for key in keys}
    for i, video_id in enumerate(arrays["ids"]):
        j = index[video_id]
        start, end = offsets[j:j+2]
        left, right = arrays["snippet_offsets"][i:i+2]
        if end - start != right - left:
            raise ValueError(f"Trace/evaluator per-video lengths differ: {video_id}")
        for key in keys:
            aligned[key].append(trace[key][start:end])
    aligned = {key: np.concatenate(value) for key, value in aligned.items()}
    if not np.allclose(aligned["scores"], arrays["scores"], rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-7):
        raise ValueError("Raw-logit score conversion/trim differs from benchmark export")
    return aligned


def analyze_benchmark(dataset, paths, output, require_trace=True):
    """Compare every treatment to V0 with the same per-video frame grid and hashes."""
    output = Path(output)

        raise ValueError("Error analysis requires same-run V0 and a treatment")

        report, arrays = load_prediction(path)

            Path(path).with_name("predictions.npz").read_bytes()).hexdigest()}

                             arrays["video_label"].tolist(), arrays["score_columns"].tolist(),
                             report["frames_per_feature"], report["visual_block_length"],
                             hashlib.sha256(arrays["frame_gt"].tobytes()).hexdigest())

            raise ValueError("V0/treatment sample/label/score/frame grids differ")
        signature = current_signature

        if len(videos) != len(arrays["ids"]) or set(videos) != set(arrays["ids"]):
            raise ValueError("Input metadata/evaluator video identities differ")
        feature_hashes = {key: value.get("feature_sha256") for key, value in videos.items()}
        if any(not value for value in feature_hashes.values()):
            raise ValueError("Missing per-video input feature provenance")
        if feature_reference is not None and feature_hashes != feature_reference:
            raise ValueError("V0/treatment per-video input feature hashes differ")
        feature_reference = feature_hashes
        trace_path = Path(path).parent / "diagnostics/diagnostic_tensors.npz"

        for column, branch in enumerate(arrays["score_columns"].astype(str)):

            replay_metrics[branch] = {"roc_auc": auc(y, score),
                                      "ap": float(average_precision_score(y, score))}
            saved = report["metrics"][branch]
            if "ano_auc" in saved:
                abnormal = np.array([str(label).casefold() not in {"a", "normal"}
                                     for label in arrays["video_label"]])
                mask = np.repeat(abnormal, np.diff(arrays["snippet_offsets"])*fpf)
                replay_metrics[branch]["ano_auc"] = auc(y[mask], score[mask])
            for metric, value in replay_metrics[branch].items():
                saved_key = "frame_ap" if metric == "ap" and "frame_ap" in saved else metric
                if saved_key in saved and (value is None or abs(value - saved[saved_key]) > 1e-9):
                    raise ValueError(f"Saved benchmark metric cannot be replayed: {variant}/{branch}/{metric}")
            if trace is not None:
                raw = trace["classification_logits"] if column == 0 else trace["alignment_log_odds"]
                raw = np.repeat(raw, fpf)
                replay_metrics[branch].update(raw_roc_auc=auc(y, raw),
                                             raw_ap=float(average_precision_score(y, raw)))
        sources[variant]["replayed_metrics"] = replay_metrics
        for i, video_id in enumerate(arrays["ids"]):
            start, end = (int(x) for x in arrays["snippet_offsets"][i:i+2])
            label = str(arrays["video_label"][i])
            y = arrays["frame_gt"][start*fpf:end*fpf].astype(bool)
            normal = label.casefold() in {"a", "normal"}
            if normal and bool(y.any()):
                raise ValueError(f"Normal video contains event frame GT: {video_id}")
            if videos[video_id]["steps"] != end - start:
                raise ValueError(f"Input feature/benchmark step count differs: {video_id}")
            if trace is not None and not np.array_equal(trace["block_index"][start:end], np.arange(end-start)//width):
                raise ValueError(f"Trace block boundaries differ from evaluator grid: {video_id}")
            gt_events = intervals(y)
            for col, branch in enumerate(arrays["score_columns"].astype(str)):
                snippet_score = arrays["scores"][start:end, col]
                score = np.repeat(snippet_score, fpf)
                predicted = score >= .5
                fp, fn = predicted & ~y, ~predicted & y
                raw = (trace["classification_logits"] if col == 0 else trace["alignment_log_odds"])[start:end] if trace else None
                raw_frame = np.repeat(raw, fpf) if raw is not None else None
                rank_auc = auc(y, score)
                raw_auc = auc(y, raw_frame) if raw_frame is not None else None
                stage = ("probability_rounding" if raw_auc is not None and rank_auc is not None and raw_auc - rank_auc > 1e-6
                         else "raw_output_ranking" if raw_auc is not None and raw_auc < .5
                         else "probability_output_ranking_no_raw_trace" if raw is None and rank_auc is not None and rank_auc < .5
                         else "fixed_threshold_decision" if (fp.any() or fn.any())
                         else "no_error_at_fixed_threshold")

                k = 1 + (end-start) // 16

                norm = trace["adapter_norm"][start:end] if trace else None
                row = {"dataset": dataset, "variant": variant, "branch": branch, "video_id": video_id,
                       "label": label, "feature_sha256": feature_hashes[video_id],
                       "steps": end-start, "frames": len(y), "block_count": (end-start+width-1)//width,
                       "padding_fraction": 1-(end-start)/(((end-start+width-1)//width)*width),

                       "observed_stage": stage, "raw_trace": raw_diagnostic,
                       "causal_origin": "unresolved; upstream stages may cause the observed output error"}
                all_rows.append(row)
                if fp.any() or fn.any() or (rank_auc is not None and rank_auc < .5):
                    evidence.append({"dataset": dataset, "variant": variant, "branch": branch,
                                     "video_id": video_id, "observed_stage": stage,

                                     "probability_auc": rank_auc, "raw_auc": raw_auc,

                for kind, mask in (("FP", fp), ("FN", fn)):

                                       "video_id": video_id, "label": label, "error": kind,
                                       "start_frame_0based": int(lo), "end_frame_exclusive": int(hi),

                for lo, hi in gt_events:

    if require_trace:

def save_checkpoint(payload, destination):
    """Publish a complete checkpoint atomically; keep the previous one on write failure."""
    destination = Path(destination)
    temporary = destination.with_name(destination.name + ".writing")
    try:
        torch.save(payload, temporary)
        temporary.replace(destination)
    finally:
        if temporary.exists():
            temporary.unlink()


def downstream_digest(model):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for name, tensor in sorted(model.state_dict().items()):
        if not name.startswith("clipmodel."):
            digest.update(name.encode())
            digest.update(tensor.detach().cpu().contiguous().numpy().tobytes())
    return digest.hexdigest()


def initialize_base(model, state, initialization):
    """B loads only frozen CLIP weights; downstream remains exactly constructor-initialized."""
    if initialization == "warm_start_v0":
        model.load_state_dict(state, strict=True)
        return {"mode": initialization, "downstream_initial_sha256": downstream_digest(model)}
    if initialization != "fresh_downstream":
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown initialization: {initialization}")
    before = downstream_digest(model)
    clip_state = {name: value for name, value in state.items() if name.startswith("clipmodel.")}
    expected_clip = {name for name in model.state_dict() if name.startswith("clipmodel.")}
    if not expected_clip or set(clip_state) != expected_clip:
        raise ValueError("Released checkpoint has incomplete/incompatible frozen CLIP weights")
    result = model.load_state_dict(clip_state, strict=False)
    if result.unexpected_keys or any(name.startswith("clipmodel.") for name in result.missing_keys):
        raise ValueError("Failed to restore the frozen CLIP backbone")
    after = downstream_digest(model)
    if before != after:
        raise RuntimeError("Fresh downstream was changed while loading frozen CLIP")
    return {"mode": initialization, "constructor_downstream_sha256": before,
            "downstream_initial_sha256": after, "v0_downstream_loaded": False,
            "frozen_clip_source": "released V0 checkpoint; no downstream keys loaded"}

    """Persist class support and stop before training if the validation task is incomplete."""
    counts = {part: (labels[indices] > 0).sum(0).tolist()
              for part, indices in (("train", train), ("development", dev))}
    missing = {part: [prompts[i] for i, count in enumerate(values) if count == 0]
               for part, values in counts.items()}
    report = {"prompt_order": prompts, "counts": counts, "missing_labels": missing,

            "do not select a multi-class alignment checkpoint on an incomplete validation set.")

def video_input(array, width, device, rng=None, trace=None):
    """One stratified temporal sample <=width for train; all original steps for dev."""
    source_steps = len(array)
    indices = np.arange(source_steps)
    if rng is not None and len(array) > width:
        boundaries = np.linspace(0, len(array), width + 1).astype(int)
        indices = np.array([rng.integers(a, max(a + 1, b))
                            for a, b in zip(boundaries[:-1], boundaries[1:], strict=True)])
        array = array[indices]
    if trace is not None:
        trace.update(source_steps=source_steps, selected_indices=indices.tolist())
    steps = len(array)
    blocks = math.ceil(steps / width)
    values = torch.zeros((blocks * width, 512), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    values[:steps] = torch.as_tensor(array, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    lengths = (steps - torch.arange(blocks) * width).clamp(max=width)
    return values.reshape(blocks, width, 512), lengths, steps


def video_scores(c, a):
    """Label-free development scores; no ground-truth choice of top-k size."""
    k = topk_size(len(c), True)
    return (float(c.sigmoid().topk(k).values.mean()),
            float((1 - a.softmax(-1)[:, 0]).topk(k).values.mean()))


def train_preflight(model, pack, ids, labels, abnormal, train, args, prompts,
                    make_mask, device, loss_config, calibrate, calibrate_bias=False,
                    conditioning=False, probe_limit=32, health=False):
    """Train-only initialization/gradient probe; no optimizer update or test inputs."""

        raise ValueError("Preflight requires normal and abnormal train videos")

                                           args.visual_length, device, np.random.default_rng(42))
            v = model.base.encode_video(x, make_mask(lengths, args.visual_length).to(device), lengths)
            norms.append(float(model.geometry.visual(v.float()).reshape(-1, v.shape[-1])[:count]
                               .norm(dim=-1).median()))

        text_norm = float(model.geometry.text(t).norm(dim=-1).median())
        visual_norm = float(np.median(norms))
        if not all(math.isfinite(n) and n > 1e-8 for n in (visual_norm, text_norm)):
            raise ValueError("Invalid train-only projector initialization norms")

            model.geometry.set_modality_norms(visual_norm, text_norm)
        elif calibrate:
            # Set median projected norm to 1 before the paper's lambda=0.7 scaling.
            model.geometry.visual.weight.div_(visual_norm)
            model.geometry.text.weight.div_(text_norm)

            distances = []
            for index in selected:
                x, lengths, count = video_input(pack.array(pack.features[ids[int(index)]]),
                                               args.visual_length, device, np.random.default_rng(42))
                v = model.base.encode_video(x, make_mask(lengths, args.visual_length).to(device), lengths)
                logits = model.geometry.classify(model.geometry.map_visual(v))
                distances.append(-logits.reshape(-1)[:count] + model.geometry.bias)
            bias = torch.cat(distances).median()
            if not torch.isfinite(bias):
                raise ValueError("Non-finite train-only classifier bias calibration")

    health_ids = {int(selected[0]), int(selected[abnormal[selected]][0])}

                       rows, numeric=(1, 2, 3, 4)), flush=True)
    print("Train-only preflight passed: finite forward/backward, BCE classifier gradients nonzero.",
          flush=True)
    return {"videos": [ids[int(i)] for i in selected], "test_data_used": False,

            raise ValueError("LATENCY_WARMUP must be an integer >= 0")
        if type(repeats) is not int or repeats < 1:
            raise ValueError("LATENCY_REPEATS must be an integer >= 1")

        self.repeats = repeats

        """Input tensors already on device; return the first measured logits."""
        device = torch.device(device)
        steps = int(steps)
        if steps < 1:
            raise ValueError("Latency requires at least one valid snippet")

        def synchronize():
            if device.type == "cuda":
                torch.cuda.synchronize(device)

        if not self.rows:
            # Warm up once per variant/dataset process. Preserve the RNG state.
            devices = []
            if device.type == "cuda":
                devices = [device.index if device.index is not None else torch.cuda.current_device()]
            with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=devices):
                with torch.no_grad():
                    for _ in range(self.warmup):
                        forward()
            synchronize()
        first = None
        with torch.no_grad():
            for repeat in range(self.repeats):
                synchronize()
                started = time.perf_counter()
                result = forward()
                synchronize()
                milliseconds = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
                if not np.isfinite(milliseconds) or milliseconds <= 0:
                    raise ValueError("Non-positive or non-finite inference duration")

                    first = result

                    "video_id": str(video_id), "repeat": repeat,
                    "snippets": steps, "input_shape": str(tuple(shape)), "input_dtype": str(dtype),

import numpy as np
from sklearn.metrics import average_precision_score, roc_auc_score


def ranked_counts(scores, positives, negatives):
    order = np.argsort(-scores, kind="stable")
    end = np.r_[np.flatnonzero(np.diff(scores[order]) != 0), len(order) - 1]
    return order, end, positives[order], negatives[order]


def weighted_metrics(ranked, video_weights):
    order, end, pos, neg = ranked
    weights = video_weights[order]
    tp = np.cumsum(pos * weights)[end]
    fp = np.cumsum(neg * weights)[end]
    if not len(tp) or tp[-1] <= 0 or fp[-1] <= 0:
        return None
    recall = tp / tp[-1]
    precision = np.divide(tp, tp + fp, out=np.zeros_like(tp), where=tp + fp > 0)
    ap = np.sum(np.diff(np.r_[0, recall]) * precision)
    x, y = np.r_[0, fp / fp[-1]], np.r_[0, recall]
    auc = np.sum(np.diff(x) * (y[1:] + y[:-1]) / 2)
    return float(auc), float(ap)


def paired_bootstrap(scores0, scores1, gt, offsets, repeats, seed=42):
    positives = gt.reshape(-1, 16).sum(1).astype(float)
    negatives = 16 - positives
    ranks = [ranked_counts(s, positives, negatives) for s in (scores0, scores1)]
    video_index = np.repeat(np.arange(len(offsets) - 1), np.diff(offsets))
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    deltas = []
    for _ in range(repeats):
        counts = rng.multinomial(len(offsets) - 1, np.full(len(offsets) - 1, 1 / (len(offsets) - 1)))
        values = [weighted_metrics(r, counts[video_index]) for r in ranks]
        if all(v is not None for v in values):
            deltas.append(np.subtract(values[1], values[0]) * 100)
    if not deltas:
        return {"requested": repeats, "valid": 0, "auc_ci95_pp": None, "ap_ci95_pp": None}
    bounds = np.quantile(deltas, [0.025, 0.975], axis=0)
    return {"requested": repeats, "valid": len(deltas),
            "auc_ci95_pp": bounds[:, 0].tolist(), "ap_ci95_pp": bounds[:, 1].tolist()}


def false_alarm_diagnostics(scores, gt, offsets):
    """Retrospective test-label operating points, NOT deployable calibrated thresholds."""
    frames = np.repeat(scores, 16)
    truth = gt.astype(bool)
    positive_video = np.zeros(len(gt), dtype=bool)
    for a, b in zip(offsets[:-1] * 16, offsets[1:] * 16, strict=True):
        positive_video[a:b] = truth[a:b].any()
    result = []
    for requested in (0.5, 0.8):
        positive_scores = np.sort(frames[truth])[::-1]
        threshold = float(positive_scores[max(0, int(np.ceil(requested * len(positive_scores))) - 1)])
        detected = frames >= threshold
        row = {"requested_recall": requested, "actual_recall": float(detected[truth].mean()),
               "threshold": threshold, "status": "retrospective_test_diagnostic_only"}
        for name, mask in (("all_background", ~truth),
                           ("background_in_positive_videos", ~truth & positive_video),
                           ("all_negative_videos", ~truth & ~positive_video)):
            row[name + "_frames"] = int(mask.sum())
            row[name + "_fp"] = int((detected & mask).sum())
            row[name + "_fpr"] = float(detected[mask].mean()) if mask.any() else None
        result.append(row)
    return result


def score_arrays(scores, gt):
    x = np.repeat(scores, 16)
    return {"roc_auc": float(roc_auc_score(gt, x)),
            "ap": float(average_precision_score(gt, x))}


import math

def event_intervals(gt, frame_offsets):
    spans = []
    owners = []
    for video, (start, stop) in enumerate(zip(frame_offsets[:-1], frame_offsets[1:], strict=True)):
        segment = gt[start:stop].astype(bool, copy=False)
        edges = np.flatnonzero(np.diff(np.r_[False, segment, False])) + start
        intervals = edges.reshape(-1, 2)
        spans.extend(intervals.tolist())
        owners.extend([video] * len(intervals))
    return np.asarray(spans, dtype=np.int64).reshape(-1, 2), np.asarray(owners, dtype=np.int64)


def operating_point(gt, scores, negative, abnormal_background, spans, fpr):
    false_budget = math.floor(fpr * len(negative))
    split = len(negative) - false_budget - 1
    cutoff = float(np.partition(negative, split)[split])
    # A strict comparison excludes the entire tie at the cutoff.
    detected = scores > cutoff
    count = np.cumsum(np.r_[0, detected])
    lengths = spans[:, 1] - spans[:, 0]
    recalls = (count[spans[:, 1]] - count[spans[:, 0]]) / lengths
    return {
        "exclusive_score_cutoff_offline": cutoff,
        "realized_background_fpr": float(detected[~gt].mean()),
        "abnormal_video_background_fpr": (
            float(detected[abnormal_background].mean()) if abnormal_background.any() else None
        ),
        "mean_event_frame_recall": float(recalls.mean()),
        "mean_short_event_frame_recall": float(recalls[lengths <= 48].mean())
        if (lengths <= 48).any() else None,

def paired_event_ci(differences, owners, videos, seed, replicates):
    if replicates == 0:
        return None
    totals = np.bincount(owners, weights=differences, minlength=videos)
    events = np.bincount(owners, minlength=videos)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    samples = rng.integers(videos, size=(replicates, videos))
    counts = events[samples].sum(axis=1)
    usable = counts > 0
    values = totals[samples[usable]].sum(axis=1) / counts[usable]
    if len(values) == 0:
        return None
    return {
        "method": "paired_video_percentile_fixed_offline_cutoffs",
        "replicates": int(usable.sum()),
        "95pct": np.quantile(values, [0.025, 0.975]).tolist(),
    }


def paired_benchmark_ci(gt, snippet_scores, offsets, frames, key, expected, seed, replicates):
    """Bootstrap videos with replacement, retaining exact frame counts and score ties."""
    if replicates == 0:
        return None
    owners = np.repeat(np.arange(len(offsets) - 1), np.diff(offsets))
    pos = gt.reshape(-1, frames).sum(axis=1)
    neg = frames - pos

    def prepare(scores):
        order = np.argsort(-scores, kind="stable")
        starts = np.r_[0, 1 + np.flatnonzero(np.diff(scores[order]) != 0)]
        return owners[order], pos[order], neg[order], starts

    def evaluate(counts, arrays):
        video, positive, negative, starts = arrays
        weights = counts[video]
        true = np.add.reduceat(positive * weights, starts)
        false = np.add.reduceat(negative * weights, starts)
        total_true, total_false = true.sum(), false.sum()
        if total_true == 0 or total_false == 0:
            return np.nan
        if key == "roc_auc":
            below = total_false - np.cumsum(false)
            return float(np.sum(true * (below + 0.5 * false)) / (total_true * total_false))
        true_cum = np.cumsum(true)
        seen = true_cum + np.cumsum(false)
        precision = np.divide(true_cum, seen, out=np.zeros_like(seen, dtype=float), where=seen > 0)
        return float(np.sum(true * precision) / total_true)

    left, right = [prepare(scores) for scores in snippet_scores]
    videos = len(offsets) - 1
    counts = np.ones(videos, dtype=np.int64)
    for arrays, target in zip((left, right), expected, strict=True):
        if not math.isclose(evaluate(counts, arrays), target, abs_tol=1e-9):
            raise ValueError("Metric bootstrap trên toàn tập lệch evaluator gốc.")
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    differences = []
    for _ in range(replicates):
        counts = np.bincount(rng.integers(videos, size=videos), minlength=videos)
        delta = evaluate(counts, right) - evaluate(counts, left)
        if np.isfinite(delta):
            differences.append(delta)
    return {
        "method": "paired_video_percentile",
        "replicates": len(differences),
        "95pct": np.quantile(differences, [0.025, 0.975]).tolist() if differences else None,
    }

import torch


def window_plan(steps, width):
    # Map each valid snippet to exactly one overlapping window.
    if width < 2 or steps <= width:
        raise ValueError("Window plan requires a multi-block video.")
    stride = width // 2
    starts = list(range(0, steps - width, stride))
    starts.append(starts[-1] + stride)
    owner = np.full(steps, -1, dtype=np.int64)
    quality = np.full(steps, -1, dtype=np.int64)
    for index, start in enumerate(starts):
        stop = min(start + width, steps)
        local = np.arange(stop - start)
        left = local if start else width
        right = stop - start - 1 - local if stop < steps else width
        context = np.minimum(left, right)
        better = context > quality[start:stop]
        quality[start:stop][better] = context[better]
        owner[start:stop][better] = index
    if (owner < 0).any():
        raise RuntimeError("Window plan missed valid snippets.")
    return [(start, np.flatnonzero(owner[start:min(start + width, steps)] == i))
            for i, start in enumerate(starts)]


def overlap_forward(forward, images, mask, text, lengths, make_mask):

    sizes = torch.as_tensor(lengths).detach().cpu().reshape(-1)
    blocks, width, channels = images.shape

        raise ValueError("Unexpected VadCLIP block lengths.")
    steps = int(sizes.sum())
    if steps <= width:
        return forward(images, mask, text, lengths)
    expected = (steps - torch.arange(blocks) * width).clamp(min=0, max=width)
    if not torch.equal(sizes, expected):
        raise ValueError("VadCLIP video blocks are not a contiguous padded sequence.")

    flat = images.reshape(-1, channels)[:steps]
    plan = window_plan(steps, width)
    for offset in range(0, len(plan), 8):
        chunk = plan[offset:offset + 8]

        valid_lengths = torch.tensor([min(width, steps - start) for start, _ in chunk])
        for row, ((start, _), length) in enumerate(zip(chunk, valid_lengths.tolist(), strict=True)):
            batch[row, :length] = flat[start:start + length]

        text_features, logits_c, logits_a = forward(batch, batch_mask, text, valid_lengths)

            result_a = logits_a.new_zeros((blocks * width, *logits_a.shape[2:]))
        for row, (start, positions) in enumerate(chunk):
            indices = torch.as_tensor(positions, device=images.device)
            result_c[start + indices] = logits_c[row, indices]
            result_a[start + indices] = logits_a[row, indices]

            raise ValueError(f"Annotation không hợp lệ: {video_id}")
        intervals = []
        for start, end in zip(bounds[::2], bounds[1::2]):

    if sha256(source) != CLIP_SHA256:

    target = cache_dir / "ViT-B-16.pt"

    cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = cache_dir / "ViT-B-16.pt.vadclip-part"
    copyfile(source, temporary)
    if sha256(temporary) != CLIP_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Bản sao CLIP lỗi. Kiểm dung lượng và file input.")
    temporary.replace(target)
    return target

        raise ValueError(f"Feature phải là số thực, nhận {array.dtype}: {path}")
    return array

def predict_video(feature, model, device, block_length, video_id):
    """Trả điểm [T, 2], lần lượt sigmoid(C) và 1-softmax(A)[Normal]."""
    steps = len(feature)
    if steps < 1 or not np.isfinite(feature).all():
        raise ValueError("Feature rỗng hoặc chứa NaN/Inf.")
    blocks = (steps + block_length - 1) // block_length
    padded = np.zeros((blocks * block_length, FEATURE_DIM), dtype=np.float32)
    padded[:steps] = feature
    lengths = torch.tensor([
        min(block_length, steps - i * block_length) for i in range(blocks)
    ])
    visual = torch.from_numpy(padded.reshape(blocks, block_length, FEATURE_DIM)).to(device)
    mask = get_batch_mask(lengths, block_length).to(device)
    with torch.no_grad():
        def dispatch():
            if VARIANT == "v7":
                t, logits_c, logits_a = overlap_forward(
                    model, visual, mask, list(CLASSES), lengths, get_batch_mask,
                )
            else:
                t, logits_c, logits_a = model(visual, mask, list(CLASSES), lengths)
            return t, logits_c, logits_a

        measured = latency.measure(
            dispatch, device, len(latency.rows) // LATENCY_REPEATS,
            steps, visual.shape, visual.dtype,
        )
        _, logits_c, logits_a = measured
        flow_trace.observe(video_id, model, dispatch, visual, lengths, mask, measured, steps,
                           getattr(full_model, "geometry", None), list(CLASSES), expected_features=feature)
        c_score = logits_c.reshape(-1)[:steps].sigmoid()

    if len(candidates) <= 1:

    official = PurePosixPath(original.replace(chr(92), "/")).parts
    for depth in range(2, len(official) + 1):
        matches = [
            (path, member)
            for path, member in candidates
            if PurePosixPath((member or path.as_posix()).replace(chr(92), "/")).parts[-depth:]
            == official[-depth:]
        ]
        if len(matches) == 1:

def file_sha(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


def resolve_checkpoint(prefix, override, directory):
    candidates = [Path(override)] if override else sorted(
        p for p in INPUT.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and (
            p.name.lower() in {f"model_{prefix}.pth", "model.pth"}
            or p.suffix.lower() == ".zip" and prefix in p.stem.lower()
            and "checkpoint" in p.stem.lower()))
    for path in candidates:
        if path.suffix.lower() == ".pth" and file_sha(path) == V0_CHECKPOINT_SHA[prefix]:
            return path
        if path.suffix.lower() == ".zip":
            with ZipFile(path) as archive:
                for member in archive.infolist():
                    if member.is_dir() or not member.filename.lower().endswith(".pth"):
                        continue
                    with archive.open(member) as stream:
                        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
                    if digest == V0_CHECKPOINT_SHA[prefix]:
                        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                        target = directory / f"model_{prefix}.pth"
                        target.write_bytes(archive.read(member))
                        if file_sha(target) != digest:
                            raise ValueError("Staged V0 checkpoint hash mismatch")
                        return target
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Attach the original pinned {prefix} V0 checkpoint (.pth or ZIP)")

                if reused is not None:

                    entry["reports"] = {name: path.relative_to(output).as_posix() for name,path in paths.items()}
                    entry["reused_completed_dataset"] = True
                    entry["recovery_receipt"] = f"{prefix}/recovery_receipt.json"
                    print(f"{prefix}: reusing completed training and evaluation; rerunning diagnostics.", flush=True)

                   for dataset, record in results.items() if record["status"] != "ok"]
        reasons.extend(f"{item['step']}: {item['error']}" for item in postprocessing_errors)
        raise RuntimeError(f"Incomplete V21 run. Partial results saved in {archive_path}\n"
                           + "\n".join(reasons))
    return archive_path
